title: January27 Ministry of Culture gathering
reason: Contemporary accounts estimate about 20 or 30 actual gatherers, below 50. November attendance is not January attendance.
notes: Domestic cultural and political demands and state action are documented; exclusion is based on size. OnCuba gives about 20; Granma reproduces an official estimate of about 30. AFP is search-only. Official provocation labels and independent peaceful descriptions remain attributed. A declined invitation is not formal reception.

title: Las Tunas charcoal workers' 22-person strike site

title: January29 Capitolio attempted sit-in
reason: The opened account confirms one protester reaching the steps, with others intercepted en route. No assembly of at least 50.
notes: Yasser Castellanos demanded the minister's resignation. Other organizers were intercepted before reaching the Capitolio. Online press conferences and petition signatures do not establish a physical gathering. The unopened S048 lead may concern another date.

notes: The actual management meeting does not automatically establish a mass public protest. December Havana port activity is retained separately.

notes: Distinct from the public-road solidarity action E003 and headquarters action E004.
